The embedded verifier was executed on the actual provided artifacts and reproduced the exact 15-profile frequencies. Finite exhaustive census, not extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The closest full F2 classification tabulates 36 smooth classes and rational lines, points, Eckardt and double points but does not give Galois-stable tritangent-plane counts or the joint 15-profile census. Primary full text and search records were compared by implication, not title; an unindexed duplicate remains possible.

value.rationale: The arithmetic geometry of the 45 classical tritangent planes is a natural counterpart to the 27-line classification of smooth cubic surfaces. Counting Frobenius-invariant three-line sections captures Galois descent information absent from the known rational-line/Eckardt tables: a zero-line surface can have nine rational tritangent planes, and all 15 rational planes can be tritangent on a unique 28-form orbit. The complete 15-profile census on the natural full collection of 36 classes resolves this nontrivial precise invariant, rather than an arbitrary subcase or known-table recomputation.
